_note: Unbounded-debt claims judged by tools/d62_pumping_witness_gate.py against the REAL D62 cold verifier (drift_canary/pumping_witness.py, PR #2318). Empty 'claims' = explicit DORMANT (never a false green). The first claim merged activates enforcement with zero new wiring. Claims are evidence declarations: the gate reconstructs the certificate from the claim's own certificate_b64 bytes and runs independent_verify — a certificate the verifier rejects is BLOCKED (exit 1); a BREACH assertion from a witness is BLOCKED as quantifier confusion (exit 1); an untrustworthy manifest is BROKEN (exit 2).

_schema.obligation_id: the scheduling obligation the unbounded upper is asserted for
_schema.evidence_ref: link to the evidence (board comment, run log, check run)
_schema.asserts: PROVEN_UNBOUNDED | BREACH — what the claim asserts. BREACH from a witness is always blocked (starvation accusation).
_schema.certificate_b64: base64 of drift_canary.pumping_witness.certificate_to_json(cert) — the minimized entry-cycle-exit certificate. The cold verifier reconstructs from these bytes alone.

_example._comment: WORKED EXAMPLE — not an active claim. If registered as a claim, the gate BLOCKS it (exit 1): the two-token defect from AER-LIVE-007. The naive shape-only checker declares this certificate PROVEN_UNBOUNDED (non-empty cycle, positive debt gain), but the real verifier rejects it — traversal #3 exhausts recovery_token (supply 2, cost 1 per traversal). Minimal counterexample at repetition 3. This is the exact false witness D62 exists to catch.
